label: Written BEFORE StudySS2 or StudySS2-32B exist on origin. Neither commit, file nor EXPERIMENTS row is present as of this commit.

item_1_codalm_parser.status: WRITTEN AND SELF-TESTED, 18 of 18 vectors pass. Gate function ready.
item_1_codalm_parser.why_new_code: the StudySS1 parser dropped 667 of 700 while reporting a working judge_mean 0.1818, the largest cause being the judge obeying the required format while the regex rejected the VALUE. A 1-10 scale with CODA-LM own prompt shares none of that regex assumptions.

THE_TRAP_AND_IT_BIT_MY_OWN_FIRST_PATTERN.what: on a 1-10 scale the danger is `10`. A pattern built from a single digit class reads 10 as 1: it does not DROP the rating, it silently returns the BOTTOM of the scale for an answer the judge placed at the TOP. That is a confident wrong number rather than a missing one, and it would not appear in a coverage figure at all.
THE_TRAP_AND_IT_BIT_MY_OWN_FIRST_PATTERN.my_first_pattern_failed_two_vectors: Rating: 11 returned 1.0 and Rating: 100 returned 10.0, both out-of-range values silently mapped onto scale endpoints.
THE_TRAP_AND_IT_BIT_MY_OWN_FIRST_PATTERN.fix: a trailing (?![\d.]) boundary on the number alternative, which is load-bearing rather than cosmetic.
THE_TRAP_AND_IT_BIT_MY_OWN_FIRST_PATTERN.lesson: the self-test was written before any data existed and caught two bugs in the parser written to avoid exactly this class. A parser gate measures COVERAGE; it cannot catch a value that parses to the wrong number, which only a vector test can.

item_1_codalm_parser.gate_rule: parser_gate() runs on 20 to 30 judge outputs and reports the parse rate BEFORE any full pass, so a 5 percent rate is caught on 30 calls rather than on the full set. No mean is published without its coverage beside it.

item_6_cut_PREREGISTERED.rationale: 6.0 is the first integer above the 5.5 midpoint of 1-10. Fixed now because an unregistered threshold already moved a StudySS1 headline by 17 points, agreement 0.633 against 0.805 on whether a judge 0.5 counts as correct.

item_2_divergence_set_procedure.rule: per dataset, count images below 65,536 px of EFFECTIVE area, post-cap, since ss1_kit downscales when the longest side exceeds 2048. Predict the divergence set BEFORE measuring parity.
item_2_divergence_set_procedure.why: tonight the prompt-token divergence was EXACTLY the images below the device min_pixels 65,536 against the cloud 4,096 override, and nothing else: VizWiz 28 of 4,319 with both residual sets empty, EgoThink 0 of 700.
item_2_divergence_set_procedure.do_not_assume_empty: VizWiz had 28 and EgoThink had 0, so the count must be measured per dataset. CODA-LM is driving scenes and likely has none; RefSpatial may be rendered or cropped and could have many.

item_3_dedup_on_content.rule: hash the staged files per dataset and derive the warm-encoding candidate set from the hashes, not from identifiers.
item_3_dedup_on_content.precedent: VizWiz val holds 34 groups of byte-identical photos under different filenames, and the by-identifier check passes clean at 4,319 of 4,319, so it could not have found them in principle.

item_4_realworldqa_option_count.rule: report the option count and the implied chance floor beside any MCQ accuracy, measured from the data rather than assumed.
item_4_realworldqa_option_count.precedent: an assumed four options on S-EMBER were actually five, which moved a result from below chance to above it.

item_5_scorer_per_subset.rule: state the scorer per subset explicitly, because the MCQ against free-form split is PARTLY A SCORER SPLIT: exact-letter match and containment or a judge are different instruments.
item_5_scorer_per_subset.precedent: two scorers disagreed on the same 700 EgoThink answers, containment giving +0.0057 with an interval including zero and the judge +0.0623 with one excluding it.

item_7_length_bias_remeasure.rule: run the within-model, within-stratum length-tercile check on CODA-LM directly rather than inheriting the EgoThink caveat.
item_7_length_bias_remeasure.why: the Mistral judge rates longer answers higher with model and containment both fixed, 0.398 to 0.580 on the device containment-0 stratum. A 1-10 scale gives MORE room to reward prose than 0/0.5/1, so the effect could be larger.

item_8_missingness_yardstick.rule: CODA-LM has reference answers, so containment against them is computable whether or not the judge emits a rating. Use it to characterise the unparsed set.
item_8_missingness_yardstick.why: the EgoThink missingness analysis only worked because containment was computable on unparsed rows, and it showed all 18 device-side unparsed answers at containment 0.0000 against 0.4839 parsed.

item_9_egothink_judge_columns: ALREADY DONE at 6acb3e9, so "add when ready" is satisfied by pointing at that commit rather than recomputing.
